projectDescription: Process invoice PDFs using Azure Blob Storage, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Python and LangChain agents for purchase-order validation and suspicious-invoice identification, finance-system output, and human review.

services.name: Review Portal
features: Invoice processing status and human review queue
Display extracted invoice fields, validation results, and suspicious-invoice findings
Allow reviewers to approve, reject, correct, and comment on invoices

services.name: Invoice Processing API
features: Orchestrate PDF intake, Azure AI Document Intelligence extraction, and LangChain agents
Validate invoice details against purchase orders
Provide finance-system output and human-review workflow APIs

services.name: Invoice Processing Worker
features: Run purchase-order validation and advanced suspicious-invoice identification agents
Route exceptions and flagged invoices to human review
